meta.title: Water bill
meta.description: A quarterly residential water and wastewater bill. It shows an account summary, usage charts against the regional average, meter readings and charges by service, with a tear-off payment slip at the foot of the last page.

main.description: One property's bill for one quarter.

vars.lastYearLitres: First(data.main.usage.history.filter(h, DateDiff(h.readDate, data.main.bill.periodEnd, 'day') > 330 && DateDiff(h.readDate, data.main.bill.periodEnd, 'day') < 400).map(h, h.litres))
vars.activity: [{'date': null, 'description': 'Your last bill', 'amount': data.main.bill.previousBalance}] + data.main.payments.map(p, {'date': p.date, 'description': p.method + ' payment, thank you', 'amount': -p.amount}) + Coalesce(data.main.adjustments, [])
vars.split: [{'label': 'Water usage', 'amount': Sum(data.main.charges.filter(c, c.service == 'Water' && c.kind == 'usage').map(c, c.amount))}, {'label': 'Water access', 'amount': Sum(data.main.charges.filter(c, c.service == 'Water' && c.kind == 'access').map(c, c.amount))}, {'label': 'Wastewater usage', 'amount': Sum(data.main.charges.filter(c, c.service == 'Wastewater' && c.kind == 'usage').map(c, c.amount))}, {'label': 'Wastewater access', 'amount': Sum(data.main.charges.filter(c, c.service == 'Wastewater' && c.kind == 'access').map(c, c.amount))}]

payment-slip.description: Tear-off payment slip: who is paying, the amount and due date, and a Code 128 barcode of the payment reference.
